heldOrRejectedSources.reason: Current OpenStax titles and editions are not uniformly CC BY; broad current licensing includes CC BY-NC-SA. Only the specifically verified College Algebra CC BY 4.0 edition is accepted.
CC BY-SA/GFDL attribution, provenance and share-alike handling for this model-development use remains unresolved in existing D1 authority.
Submission licenses vary; public availability does not establish uniform redistribution or training rights.
Work-level copyright status, jurisdiction and Project Gutenberg terms require a separately frozen selection policy.

heldOrRejectedSources.source: arbitrary web crawl, paywalled/login content or robots-bypassing acquisition
heldOrRejectedSources.reason: No bounded source identity or rights basis and directly conflicts with network safety policy.

deviationsFromLongRun: general prose reduced from 25% to 10% because no broad, clean, clearly compatible general-prose source is authorized
government and technical content increased for authoritative machine-accessible sources
multilingual content reduced from 6% to 5% and structured factual text from 4% to 2%
quality and rights take precedence over forcing target percentages

networkSafetyPolicy.retryPolicy: retry only transient connection/429/5xx failures within source and global limits; no retry for rights, redirect, type or scope failures

rawArtifactImmutabilityPolicy.collisionBehavior: store under new retrieval/version identity or fail closed; never replace an existing byte identity
